changes: The PowerShell member saves the real dwProcessId/dwThreadId from the ABI-verified PROCESS_INFORMATION (escape-real.pid/.tid); the cmd-side %PID% echo placeholder is removed.
The waitable process handle hP is retained until the member dies (pins the kernel object against PID reuse); the thread handle is released.

A test-owned observer outside the owned job (direct child of the test, surviving job teardown) resolves the saved dwProcessId to its own SYNCHRONIZE|PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION handle, waits, and records mode/pid/exitCode/waitMsElapsed/aliveAtOpen/seenAfterMs. Modes creation-refused, pid-file-missing, pid-invalid, open-failed, wait-failed (WAIT_FAILED), wait-timeout (WAIT_TIMEOUT) each stay non-proof of death; heartbeat freeze (beatFrozen) and test-cleanup inference (pidDeadByFile) were removed as evidence paths.

Classification: creationRefused = observer creation-refused + refusal file + no real PID; kernelExit = WAIT_OBJECT_0 + real PID file + escape.log exists + exitCode 1, the job owner's TerminateJobObject(job,1) signature; an actual escapee never exits on its own and records wait-timeout, which fails closed. ABI layout assertions kept; no ExecutionPolicy Bypass; no reimplementation of ownership.

observedOutcome.platformResult: created-but-contained (NOT refused): on this host CreateProcessW with CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB succeeds and the created process stays inside the job, terminated by it at the deadline
observedOutcome.evidenceChain: Verified layout size=24;pid@16;tid@20; kernel-filled dwProcessId pinned by the member's hP; observer confirmed STILL_ACTIVE at open; WaitForSingleObject returned WAIT_OBJECT_0; GetExitCodeProcess = 1, exactly the helper's TerminateJobObject(job,1) exit code; the writer payload had advanced escape.log for two to three seconds (2000+ beats) before the deadline kill. Both platform outcomes (refused vs created-and-contained) are distinguished, neither fabricated.
